entries.title: Synchrony Refused, Connection Kept — SAFEr Grid
entries.summary: SAFEr Grid (ERC Synergy, RWTH Aachen/Aalborg) replaces the synchronous 50 Hz balance of power with store-and-forward balancing of energy between decoupled subgrids. One carrier, grid frequency, is made to serve four contextures that do not share a logic; the project turns frequency from operator into operand. Certified third technically, uncertified institutionally.

entries.title: Where Compute Can Return — Kozani data centre

signature.en: The right ground, the wrong temperature
signature.de: Der richtige Ort, die falsche Temperatur
signature.el: Ο σωστός τόπος, η λάθος θερμοκρασία

verdict.en: Uncertified as announced; conditional if reconfigured

entries.summary: PPC data centre (300 MW, AWS lease) at the closed Agios Dimitrios lignite plant, Kozani. The right site (fit 12/15) with a configuration that returns too little (6/15, reciprocity 0.5), above all heat: 41 °C waste heat offered to greenhouses while the town lost its district heating. OD 4.
entries.tool: CCR-NRG site-scoring sheet (fit, return, tension, OD, reciprocity, three refusals)

entries.title: The Right Temperature, the Wrong Ground — Amsterdam-Zuidoost

signature.en: The right temperature, the wrong ground
signature.de: Die richtige Temperatur, der falsche Ort
signature.el: Η σωστή θερμοκρασία, ο λάθος τόπος

entries.summary: Equinix campus at Amstel III, Amsterdam-Zuidoost: a weak site (fit 6/15) with a comparatively generous configuration (return 8/15, free residual heat). Grid congested until about 2036, scarce water, 5,500–8,000 homes planned on the same grid, a grandfathered permit despite the 2025 moratorium. Mirror image of Kozani. OD 5.
